corrections: Initial new fixtures used an invalid weather enum and assumed which guardian the fair ordering would select; fixed fixtures, preserving actual co-location assertions.
Family apprenticeship now requires physical proximity; updated old fixture to put learner and mentor together.
Found hungry children excluded from ordinary availability; allow actual food delivery at night and prioritize hunger without producing resources.
Existing injuries start new waiting-time observation on upgrade; no historical first-care timestamp is invented.
Creator/upload/motion browser failures passed on targeted rerun with stable source. Full run overlapped edits/reloads, so no production failure is inferred from these alone.

Voluntary construction can be delayed by care and survival. Fixture allows three separately authorized 144-tick days and waits for reset rendering before applying a fence. A first 432-tick command attempt correctly failed schema validation; a later stale-render click was also recorded before fixing the wait.
limits: Joint escorts group at most three children from the same household; other-household children retain individual escorts.
Growth memories are bounded to eight people per kind (24 total), backed by first and latest events.
Old injuries use post-upgrade observation, not an inferred historical first visit.
Long-run survival and population growth are not guaranteed; actual deaths and blockers remain in the report.
Node timings are not production CPU/memory. Real Chrome model quality and human fun evaluation were not performed.
Some checkpoints exceed the pre-existing 12 MB archive state limit; internal compaction/replay and the existing large-history archive browser case are separate evidence.
maxCareWaitTicks in the regression is the retained daily-sampled comparison field. Use careMetrics.maxFirstCare/maxGap for every-tick individual injury observations, including completed injuries.

long_regression.accounting: Food, wood, coins and every urban goods ledger balanced at every daily checkpoint
